name: NordikMC | Everything you do pays | No P2W
description:
YOU GET PAID FROM THE SECOND YOU LOG IN

No sign-up. No menu. No class to pick.

Mine a block, get paid. Chop a tree, get paid. Farm, fish, hunt, dig, or just cover ground on foot. It all pays, instantly, from your first minute.

LEVEL UP, UNLOCK MORE LAND

Every level you gain, your land limit goes up. Every five hours you play, it goes up again.

Your first four chunks are free. No rank to buy. No rank to grind for. Just play.

GET RICH BEFORE ANYONE ELSE DOES

Nobody has set the prices yet. The market is wide open. Build chest shops and they keep selling for you while you are offline, even while you sleep.

And nobody at the top of this server got there with a bot or a mob grinder. The rich list is people who actually played.

BOUNTIES, WARZONE, QUESTS

There are bounties on players. There is a warzone when you want a real fight. There are quests when you want a target, levels to climb, and a random teleport that drops you somewhere nobody has touched.

JAVA AND BEDROCK, SAME WORLD

Play on your phone with your friend on PC. Same map, same economy, same everything. English and French, both properly.

NOBODY CAN BUY THEIR WAY PAST YOU

No pay-to-win, ever. Looks and small comforts are the only things that will ever be for sale. No gear, no stats, no money, no flying over the map. Nothing you can buy puts you ahead of someone who played longer.

Your rank here is your playtime. That is it.

THE ALPHA SET IS GONE FOREVER AFTER SEASON 1

Join during the alpha and the Alpha Set is yours permanently, plus the [Alpha] tag beside your name on the Season 1 world. The Alpha Wings join the set at Season 1.

Then it is retired for good and never handed out again. There is one way to own it, and this is it.

Every leaderboard is empty. Every top spot is unclaimed. Right now.

play.nordikmc.com
